events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in Bethel, New York, in 1969.

angles.name: Peace, Love, and Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on!

events.title: Elvis Presley's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, today. His music and iconic style continue to influence generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's passing
events.blurb: The music world marks the anniversary of the tragic shooting of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since the tragic events in Las Vegas, the impact of Tupac Shakur's music and message remains as powerful as ever. A true legend.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix in London in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago, we lost a true guitar god. Jimi Hendrix's innovative sound continues to inspire musicians and captivate fans worldwide.

events.title: Abbey Road album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Across the Zebra Crossing
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago today, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous images in music history, isn't it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the iconic lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and still as cool as ever. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman and Britpop icon Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that unmistakable rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite tune from the main man?

events.title: Imagine album anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his critically acclaimed second studio album, 'Imagine', in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless album with a message that resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: iPod launch anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first generation of its revolutionary iPod portable music player in 2001.

angles.name: The Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when you could fit '1,000 songs in your pocket'? Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod changed how we listened to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the very first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, of course) to over six decades of espionage, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the unparalleled talent and enduring spirit of John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Veteran actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: White Album anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: The White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles gave us the sprawling masterpiece that is 'The White Album'. So many iconic tracks, which one's your favourite?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of Queen frontman and rock legend Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Performer
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury today. Thirty-five years on, his voice and stage presence remain unmatched. The show must go on!
